caption:
Referrals are the best lead you'll ever get. And the worst plan you'll ever have.

Both are true.

Warm, pre-sold, free. If most of your work comes from word of mouth, your service is genuinely good.

But run the test: it's the 12th, you're behind, and you need three more jobs this month. What do you actually do?

The honest answer is wait and hope. You can't schedule referrals. You can't forecast from them. You can't turn them up.

That's not a strategy. That's weather.

📌 Send this to the business owner whose entire pipeline is word of mouth. Especially if they just had a slow month and couldn't explain why.

Free 20-minute audit in bio.
